notes: Check the page in spring for 2027.
name: UMD Volcano Camp for Prince George's County students
org: University of Maryland, Department of Geology
what_you_do: One week of learning why volcanoes erupt and which ones are the most dangerous. You do hands-on volcano research.
who_can_apply: High school students from Prince George's County. No grade levels listed (UMD's camp list says grades 10 to 12).
deadline_text: 2026: applications open until slots filled, acceptances due May 15, 2026. 2027 dates not posted.
how_to_apply: Fill out the high school student interest form linked on the camp page. Contact: Megan Newcombe, newcombe@umd.edu.
